subtitle: Add optimistic updates to the task list

blocks.x: Overall this is a **solid change** — the optimistic flow in `useOptimisticTasks` is clean. Two things block merge and a couple of nits below.

blocks.title: Race: mutation can be lost on rapid edits
blocks.x: When two edits fire within the same tick, `qc.cancelQueries` cancels the first mutation's refetch but the rollback snapshot is overwritten. Capture the snapshot *before* calling cancel.

blocks.title: Missing error toast on rollback
blocks.x: Rollback restores state silently. Surface a toast so the user knows the change didn't persist.
